source: original audit builds every finite input internally; this descriptor is not an external input read by the original
profiles: for m1..8, every pair A,C of slot subsets; A empty denotes outsideOPT customer incidence, not zero-customer game
present_marginals: each i in C, formal removal C minus i
submodularity: each unordered pair of missing slots i,j from [m] minus C
owner_static: each owner in A separately, all static owner choices
prefix: A nonempty, each i in sorted(A); fixed anchors A∩[0,i], every future subset of positions>i, query suffixes independently worst; no single shared policy built
owner_prefix: owner_slots={min(A)} only, not arbitraryowner prefix verification
